what: First LoRA run of Llama 3.2 1B Instruct (rank 16, 2 epochs, 6000 cause + 3000 sentence examples), before the data-audit fixes (rules as of commit 076976e). Read from /content/res and /content/lora1b on Colab (A100), 2026-11-15/16. The per-case JSON files stay on the Colab runtime and the HF model repo.
notes: Rejected sentences are replaced by the station's standard sentence, so a rejection costs wording, not correctness.
Dev split overlapped training combinations in this run (fixed in b3a167b); test, alt and real were held out.
The 8da4w export merged the adapter into Meta's checkpoint (112 matrices) and quantised with group size 32.
